title: Fppf stack descent and universal stackification
statement: Let S be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and use its big fppf site [def-pc-fppf-site]. Use the categories fibred in groupoids, base-preserving functors and vertical natural transformations of [def-sfb-stable-pointed-moduli-groupoids]. An fppf stack is such a category with sheaves of isomorphisms and effective descent for objects: in the total-category encoding a cartesian section over every covering sieve admits a colimiting cocone over the canonical base cocone. For a base-preserving functor i:P→A, precomposition sends a base-preserving functor F:A→Y to F∘i, and sends vertical natural transformations by left whiskering. Say that i is an fppf stackification when P is fibred in groupoids, A is an fppf stack, and precomposition is an equivalence of categories of based functors and vertical transformations for every fppf stack Y. The test stacks Y lie in the same chosen universes as A; P may be smaller. This is the universal-property definition, equivalent to the local-image and arrow-sheafification description of Stacks 02ZP. This definition neither chooses a stackification object nor asserts its existence.
